title: Scope start_default's reservation refusal to declared-path overlap or same-session holds
action: In policy.rs: add a `paths: &[String]` parameter to `start_default` (place it immediately before `workflows`, mirroring `start_lane`) and pass `&paths` from `run_start_feature`'s non-lane branch. Replace the blanket reservation precondition (currently 'startFeature: refused - N active reservation(s) remain (...). FIX: release them first (bee reservations release).') with two scoped refusals, both reading the SAME `list_reservations(&root_s, true, now_ms())` result once. (1) Same-session holds: reservations whose `session` field equals the trimmed acting `session_id` (skip entirely when `session_id` is None or empty). Refuse naming those holds via `resv_disp`, FIX = 'release your own hold(s) first (bee reservations release --agent <agent>)' listing the caller's own agent value(s) - never a bare `bee reservations release`. (2) Peer path overlap: reservations whose `session` differs from the acting session AND whose `path` overlaps one of the non-empty trimmed `paths` entries, using `paths_overlap` exactly as the lane branch (d) does. Mirror the lane FIX wording: 'FIX: wait for release/expiry, or start over non-overlapping paths.' Never instruct the caller to release another session's holds. Leave the claimed-cells precondition below and every other precondition byte-identical. In tests.rs: fix the existing `start_default(...)` call sites for the new parameter (pass `&[]`), and add regression tests covering: a peer session's reservation over an unrelated path no longer refuses a default start; a peer's reservation that DOES overlap a declared `--paths` entry refuses with the wait/non-overlapping wording and never invites releasing it; a same-session leftover hold refuses with a FIX naming `--agent`.

truths: A live peer's reservation in another worktree over a path this start does not declare no longer refuses bee state start-feature
No refusal message on this path tells the caller to release another session's reservations

deviations: Also touched crates/bee/tests/workflow_verbs.rs (not a cell-declared file): its start_feature_refuses_over_an_active_reservation_with_zero_mutations test exercised exactly the old blanket-refusal behavior D1 removes, so it went red under the fix; renamed it to assert the new declared-path-overlap refusal and added a companion test for the now-allowed unrelated-path case, to keep the full-suite proof green.

report.outcome: start_default now takes paths like start_lane and refuses only on the caller's own leftover reservation holds or a peer hold overlapping a declared --paths entry; the old unscoped blanket refusal and its release-a-peer's-holds FIX line are gone.
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml — green — full workspace suite per the cell's declared verify command: 2045 passed, 11 ignored, 0 failed
deviations: Touched crates/bee/tests/workflow_verbs.rs, outside the cell's declared files, to fix an integration test that encoded the exact blanket-refusal behavior D1 removes.
